lines.beaver: 나 요즘 고민이 있어. 들어 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: I've been worried lately. Will you listen?
lines.beaver_roman: Na yojeum gomini isseo. Deureo jullae?
lines.learner: 그럼. 무슨 일인데? 편하게 말해 봐.
lines.en: Of course. What's up? Tell me.
lines.roman: Geureom. Museun irinde? Pyeonhage malhae bwa.

lines.beaver_en: Things got awkward with Sujin, my classmate.
lines.learner: 수진이는 네 과제 파트너잖아. 무슨 일 있었어?
lines.en: Sujin's your project partner. What happened?
lines.roman: Sujinineun ne gwaje pateuneojana. Museun il isseosseo?

lines.beaver: 과제를 거의 나 혼자 했어. 화가 나.
lines.beaver_en: I did almost all the work alone. I'm upset.
lines.beaver_roman: Gwajereul geoui na honja haesseo. Hwaga na.
lines.en: Have you talked honestly with Sujin?

lines.beaver_en: No, I stayed quiet in case it hurt our friendship.
lines.learner: 말 안 하면 오해가 쌓여. 얘기해 봐.
lines.en: If you don't talk, misunderstandings pile up. Talk to her.
lines.roman: Mal an hamyeon ohaega ssayeo. Yaegihae bwa.

lines.beaver: 그래도 도저히 먼저 말을 못 꺼내겠어.
lines.beaver_en: Still, I just can't bring it up first.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraedo dojeohi meonjeo mareul mot kkeonaegesseo.
lines.en: Can I give you some advice?

lines.beaver: 응, 해 줘. 네 말은 잘 들을게.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, please. I'll listen to you.
lines.beaver_roman: Eung, hae jwo. Ne mareun jal deureulge.
lines.learner: 최소한 한 번은 시도해 봐. 짧게라도.
lines.en: At least try once. Even briefly.
lines.roman: Choesohan han beoneun sidohae bwa. Jjalgerado.

lines.beaver_en: How should I start the conversation?
lines.learner: "요즘 바빴어?" 하고 물으면서 손길을 내밀어 봐.
lines.en: Ask, "Have you been busy lately?" and offer a helping hand.
lines.roman: "Yojeum bappasseo?" hago mureumyeonseo sonkkireul naemireo bwa.

lines.beaver_en: A helping hand? You mean I help her first?
lines.learner: 응. 서로 돕는 거니까 먼저 다가가 봐.
lines.en: Yes. It's about helping each other, so reach out first.
lines.roman: Eung. Seoro domneun geonikka meonjeo dagaga bwa.

lines.beaver: 네 말 들으니까 좀 용기가 나네.
lines.beaver_en: Hearing you gives me some courage.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne mal deureunikka jom yonggiga nane.
lines.learner: 둘이 뭉치면 과제도 더 잘될 거야.
lines.en: If you two team up, the project will go better.
lines.roman: Duri mungchimyeon gwajedo deo jaldoel geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I'll talk to Sujin tomorrow.
lines.learner: 잘될 거야. 끝나면 꼭 이야기해 줘!
lines.en: It'll go well. Tell me how it went!
lines.roman: Jaldoel geoya. Kkeunnamyeon kkok iyagihae jwo!
